purpose: A link or menu trigger in a header or navbar: a label with an optional icon, count Badge and caret; Current marks the page you are on.

notFor.case: A row in the app sidebar.
A destination in a mobile bottom bar.
An action that is not navigation.

Hover.visual: Ink Content/primary on Action/ghost/hover; the caret stays Content/secondary.

Focused.visual: Ink Content/secondary, no fill; a Border/focus stroke with the Border/ring/default ring.

Current.meaning: The page you are on: aria-current="page".
Current.visual: Ink Content/accent on Surface/selected; the caret stays Content/secondary.

Disabled.visual: Ink and caret in Content/disabled, no fill.

a11y.role: link (or a button as a menu trigger, through asChild)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter follows the link. As a menu trigger it also needs aria-expanded.
a11y.reducedMotion: Fill and ink changes run on use-hover, which keeps its duration under reduced motion: a colour change, not travel (lib/motion.ts KEEP_UNDER_REDUCED).

openQuestions: With a caret it opens a NavigationMenu, which is not an Escala component in the index. Which component opens from it?
